items.source: Indicate whether the underlying script data has been modified since the last time getScriptAsString() was called. Returns true if the script has not been read yet.
items.translation: 指示自上次调用getScriptAsString()以来，底层脚本数据是否已修改。如果尚未读取脚本，则返回true。
